fusions.name: Echo Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps once and sends the echo ahead, dealing 4 damage to the first enemy it meets with a 20% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Let Go the Rafter
fusions.desc: Drops onto a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 30 damage, up to 1.5 times that from the full distance. It always lands as a critical hit, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Soundless Passage
fusions.desc: You are veiled for 9 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later. Attacking breaks the veil. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Dusk Stalker
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 12% more damage, and your dodge chance rises by 5% at all times.
